requirements.statement: Map non-text content to the WCAG 2.2 Non-text Content success criterion and preserve its exception conditions.
requirements.evidence: Versioned success-criterion mapping and content-scope evidence.

requirements.statement: Map focus-visibility findings to the WCAG 2.2 Focus Not Obscured (Minimum) success criterion when the declared content scope applies.
requirements.evidence: Keyboard/focus evidence and versioned criterion mapping.

requirements.statement: Map pointer-target findings to the WCAG 2.2 Target Size (Minimum) success criterion when the declared content scope applies.
requirements.evidence: Target-size evidence and versioned criterion mapping.

requirements.statement: Evaluate conformance only against the WCAG 2.2 conformance requirements, full-page scope, and declared conformance level; never infer a certification claim.
requirements.evidence: Conformance-level, full-page, alternate-version, and external applicability evidence.

applicability_rule: Applicability is evaluated from external jurisdiction/entity/activity/data/version/effective-date evidence; this file never stores project facts.
exception_rule: Exceptions require an external primary-source or authority-corpus reference and remain requirement-level mappings.
